plugins.name: claugentic-dev-harness
plugins.description: Reusable, self-improving Claude Code development harness: a staged workflow, specialist agent roles, an ISO/IEC 25010 standards catalog, and deterministic architecture enforcement — with three live skills, /claugentic-dev-harness:init (scaffold), /claugentic-dev-harness:audit (audit → backlog), and /claugentic-dev-harness:build (drive your backlog — one item, several, or a whole tier — through the reviewed pipeline to the honest stop-signal, re-checking touched code between items).
